objective: Repair spacing, unstable click targets and flashes when moving between learning pages.

baseline.method: Cold local production build; 800 ms delay on new JavaScript requests; animation-frame sampling during Today to Practice.

changes: Stable Suspense boundary and React transition retain the current page until the destination loads.
Intent preloading on navigation focus/hover and on route activation; cold Today keeps full teaching bodies deferred.
Route query snapshots keep outgoing grammar, vocabulary, verbs, diagnostics and chapters in their existing mode while a new URL loads.
Instant scroll at page commit, consistent page padding, stable scrollbar gutter and footer placement.
Aligned main practice actions, calmer text actions and stationary hover/pressed targets.
Matching document background before application styles load.

browser.visualInteraction: Shared browser-view Chromium: screenshot inspection and pointer navigation between Practice, Grammar and Verbs. Automated keyboard activation, focus placement and disclosure checks in owned profiles.

preservation: No curriculum IDs, progress schema, learner databases or source materials changed. Browser navigation preserves synthetic notebook and unfinished answers; failure/reload retains drafts.
evidence: Raw frame traces and screenshots remain in ignored work/navigation-audit/. Reproduce with scripts/audit_navigation_browser.mjs against a built preview.
limitations: Synthetic owned Chromium profiles; 800 ms delays affect new JavaScript requests. This is a navigation/layout regression check, not a real-device network benchmark.
No physical-device or full screen-reader audit. Real network timing varies; zero blank frames refers to the recorded navigation scenarios.
